system_sql.action: monthly totals of dashboard performance by region, with the month-over-month change and percentage change computed.
system_sql.sql:
WITH monthly_support AS (
    SELECT 
        c.region,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', st.created_at)::date AS month,
        COUNT(st.id) AS total_tickets,
        AVG(st.resolution_time) AS avg_resolution_time
    FROM 
        support_tickets st
    JOIN 
        customers c ON st.customer_id = c.id
    GROUP BY 
        c.region, month
),
monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', date)::date AS month,
        ROUND(SUM(total_revenue)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue
    FROM 
        revenue
    GROUP BY 
        region, month
),
monthly_performance AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.region,
        ms.month,
        ms.total_tickets,
        ms.avg_resolution_time,
        mr.total_revenue
    FROM 
        monthly_support ms
    JOIN 
        monthly_revenue mr ON ms.region = mr.region AND ms.month = mr.month
)
SELECT 
    region,
    month,
    total_tickets,
    avg_resolution_time,
    total_revenue,
    total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month) AS revenue_change,
    ROUND((total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month), 0) * 100, 2) AS percentage_change
FROM 
    monthly_performance
WHERE 
    region = 'APAC'
ORDER BY 
    month

monthly_totals AS (

    FROM

        customers c ON st.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE

    GROUP BY 
        c.region, month
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        mt.region,
        mt.month,
        mt.total_failures,
        LAG(mt.total_failures) OVER (PARTITION BY mt.region ORDER BY mt.month) AS previous_month_failures
    FROM 
        monthly_totals mt
)
SELECT 
    mc.region,
    mc.month,
    mc.total_failures AS current_month_failures,
    COALESCE(mc.total_failures - mc.previous_month_failures, 0) AS month_over_month_change,
    ROUND(COALESCE((mc.total_failures - mc.previous_month_failures) / NULLIF(mc.previous_month_failures, 0)::numeric, 0) * 100, 2) AS percentage_change

WITH monthly_refunds AS (
    SELECT 
        customers.region AS region,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', refunds.created_at) AS month,

),
monthly_totals AS (

        region,
        month,
        total_refund_count,
        total_refund_amount,
        LAG(total_refund_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month) AS previous_refund_count,
        LAG(total_refund_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month) AS previous_refund_amount
    FROM 
        monthly_refunds
)
SELECT 
    region,
    month,
    total_refund_count,
    total_refund_amount,
    total_refund_count - COALESCE(previous_refund_count, 0) AS month_over_month_refund_count_change,
    ROUND((total_refund_count - COALESCE(previous_refund_count, 0))::numeric / NULLIF(previous_refund_count, 0) * 100, 2) AS percentage_change_refund_count,
    ROUND(total_refund_amount - COALESCE(previous_refund_amount, 0), 2) AS month_over_month_refund_amount_change,
    ROUND((total_refund_amount - COALESCE(previous_refund_amount, 0))::numeric / NULLIF(previous_refund_amount, 0) * 100, 2) AS percentage_change_refund_amount
FROM 
    monthly_totals
